description_en: Calls the Professional Edition of Machine Translation to return translation results
description_zh: 调用机器翻译专业版获取翻译结果
kebab_example: aliyun alimt translate-ecommerce --format-type text --target-language zh --source-language en --source-text Hello --scene social --api-version 2018-10-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TranslateECommerce

parameters.help_en: The format of the text. Valid values: html and text. If you set this parameter to html, the source text and the translated text are processed as HTML. If you set this parameter to text, the source text and the translated text are processed as plain text
parameters.help_zh: 翻译文本的格式，html（ 网页格式。设置此参数将对待翻译文本以及翻译后文本按照html格式进行处理）、text（文本格式。设置此参数将对传入待翻译文本以及翻译后结果不做文本格式处理，统一按纯文本格式处理
parameters.name: format_type

parameters.help_en: The target language. For more information about the supported languages, see Language codes (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html)
parameters.help_zh: 目标语种，支持的语种参考 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html)
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en: The source language. For more information, see <props="china">Language codes (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158269.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.53746614hvrF2G)</props><props="intl">Language codes (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/158269.html)</props>
parameters.help_zh: 原文语言<props="china">参考语言code (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158269.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.53746614hvrF2G)</props><props="intl">参考语言code (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/158269.html)</props>
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The translation scenario. Valid values: \`title\` (product titles), \`description\` (product descriptions), \`communication\` (product communications), \`medical\`, \`social\`, and \`finance\`
parameters.help_zh: 场景可选取值：商品标题（title），商品描述（description），商品沟通（communication），医疗（medical），社交（social)，金融（finance）
parameters.name: scene

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates that the request was successful

WordCount.description_en: The number of characters in the source text

Message.description_en: The error message returned if the request fails. If the request is successful, this parameter is empty
Message.description_zh: 请求错误信息，如果正确则空

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. This is used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求唯一串，方便后期排查定位问题
